purpose: Official-only structure kernel complement to the from-scratch v67 neural models
source_data: Verified v67 official-only molecular features and exact v67 global scaffold folds
kernel: Equal chiral Morgan/feature-Morgan binary Tanimoto kernels, with squared Tanimoto component and optional 15% fit-only physicochemical RBF
selection: Compare raw kernel variants to frozen v67 shared/gated selections under the same three scaffold folds. Select mean gain minus 0.1 SD, mean >0.002 and >=2 positive folds and leave-fold selection mean >0.001. On a fresh global scaffold split re-fit same kernels and compare to v67 freshly retrained neural control at its frozen selected weight. Positive fresh blend gain required. No official valid selection or veto.
cv_caveat: v67 neural weights and v68 kernel weights selected on reused development folds; leave-fold diagnostics are not unbiased nested full-pipeline estimates.
